Anti-Ragging Committee

Ragging is a criminal offence and the regulations on curbing the menace of ragging apply to every student of the university and its constituent colleges.

Students in distress due to ragging related incidents

  • Can call the National Anti-Ragging Helpline l800-180-5522 {24x7 Toll Free) or email the Anti-Ragging Helpline at helplin@antiragqins.in . For any other information regarding ragging please visit www.antiragging.in

Contact the anti-ragging cell of the university at antiragging.cell@somaiya.edu for campus matters.
